candidate_name: Walvis Bay LNG Import Terminal (Helios / Nathaniel Maxuilili Power Plant)
sponsor_or_proposer: Helios Investment Partners (lead); concept originated by Power Invest DMCC and Ariya Capital
current_state: Helios Investment Partners has 'taken the lead on the planning and development' of a Walvis Bay LNG import terminal (FSU + regasification + 12.7 km pipeline) feeding the proposed 586 MW Nathaniel Maxuilili Power Plant — the renamed Xaris/Walvis GasPort concept that GEM holds as the cancelled Walvis Bay LNG Terminal (T100000130622, Excelerate-linked, cancelled 2024). Namport's port master plan separately keeps an LNG jetty incorporating an FSRU at the Walvis Bay North Port ('LPG and LNG terminals planned for the North Port within the next 5 years'; 'LNG importers are already talking to Namport and have projects in the conceptual phase'). Nov 2024 Reuters reporting says Namibia is consolidating offshore-gas plans into a single common-infrastructure scheme, which may supersede this concept.

watch_for: A dated Helios/NMPP announcement (EIA renewal, FSU charter, FEED, FID); outcome of Namibia's single common-infrastructure gas plan; Namport North Port LNG jetty concession. If it firms up: new lead sponsor (Helios) but same site/design as the dead record — make the dead-and-revived hand decision then; if staged as new, set AssociatedTerminals → T100000130622.

candidate_name: Lüderitz Angra Point LNG Export Terminal
sponsor_or_proposer: Namibian Ports Authority (Namport) port master plan; no project sponsor yet
current_state: Namport port-engineering planning states 'LNG exports planned from Lüderitz Angra Point' and 'LNG landing and processing is viable in Lüderitz or E-bay. LNG exports only from Lüderitz.' Angra Point deep-water port expansion is in design (EU/Port of Rotterdam NAD 13m planning partnership signed Nov 2025, aimed first at green minerals/ammonia); the first Angra Point terminal is planned as green-ammonia export (~2028), with later terminals demand-driven. LNG export would monetize Orange Basin gas (Venus/Mopane/Kudu).

watch_for: A named LNG developer or NOC (NAMCOR) taking the Angra Point LNG concept; Orange Basin gas-monetization decisions (Venus FID, Gas Master Plan); Namport port-masterplan study completion; any liquefaction FEED/EIA at Lüderitz.

sponsor_or_proposer: TotalEnergies (Venus; operator of PEL 83/Mopane since 2026), Galp (stakes in PEL 56/91), BW Energy (Kudu, gas-to-power), NAMCOR
current_state: Upstream oil-operator sweep (Discovery SOP §4.3): Namibia's Gas Master Plan positions Venus/Mopane/Kudu gas at the center of energy strategy; NAMCOR cites 'offshore FLNG solutions and pipeline-fed gas-to-power projects capable of delivering up to 800 MW' among monetization options (Apr 2026).
